args.subject: Urgent: GR confirmation needed for PO-48060 (Kestrel Electronics)
args.message: Hi Receiving, Kestrel Electronics state they delivered all of PO-48060 (24 pallets) on 24 March and that our dock signed for it. No goods receipt is posted in the ERP for PO-48060, and their invoice KE-15050 (USD 23,720.50, due today) is payment-blocked for missing GR. Could you please check and either post the GR or confirm in writing (quantity and receipt date) that the goods were received in full, so we can release the block and pay today? Thanks, FinOps

args.subject: Re: Kestrel KE-15050 / PO-48060
args.message: Hi Omar, I can't pay KE-15050 yet. Invoice 5100004467 (USD 23,720.50, due today) is blocked for GR_MISSING and there is still no goods receipt for PO-48060 in the ERP. Receiving's 30 March note says last week's GRs were posted, but nothing exists for PO-48060, and we have no written confirmation from Receiving. Under our rules I can only post a GR on Receiving's written confirmation and release a block once the cause is resolved. I've emailed Receiving asking them urgently to post the GR or confirm in writing. As soon as they do, I'll release the block and send a same-day wire. I've also sent Kestrel a payment advice saying the payment is on hold pending GR confirmation. FinOps
